description: This file defines a handler class for logging and processing responses from Google Vertex AI passthrough endpoints. It manages different response types like predict, generate content, search, and batch prediction jobs, performing response transformation, logging, and cost tracking. It also includes utility functions for extracting model identifiers from URLs and paths, and for managing batch job objects.
